messages:
anya (eng-security): flagging an incident: several DSAR deletion tasks started erroring after today's automated key rotation. deletion-service logs show `PERMISSION_DENIED` and some `DECRYPTION_FAILED`. @sam can you confirm what the rotation changed?
sam (eng-platform): I applied keystore rotation at 04:12 UTC per cron. rotation script created new key version and updated key metadata. I thought we kept bindings intact, but quick check shows the `dsar-processor@redwood-prod` SA lost the cryptoKeyDecrypter role on the active version. investigating why binding update didn't persist.
jules (eng-sre): impact: about 17 pending deletion jobs are blocked in "waiting-for-decrypt" state. some retries returning 403. stack: `kms.cryptoKeyVersions.accessDenied`. We should triage asap.
marta (privacy): how close are any DSARs to SLA breach? if even one crosses, legal needs to be notified. pulling queue now.
anya (eng-security): also seeing that the rotation runbook didn't emit an audit-check event. we should have an audit log entry stating which principals were validated post-rotation.
sam (eng-platform): hmm, the runbook step that syncs IAM bindings to new key version failed with transient API error and script didn't retry. I have the logs.
audit-bot: log entry: user:sam@redwood action:kms.keys.update time:2026-03-21T04:12:08Z resource:projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/retention/cryptoKeys/dsar-key
jules (eng-sre): mitigation idea: recreate binding for dsar-processor with least privilege role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for the new version only, retry jobs. prefer temporary fix rather than rolling back rotation.
sam (eng-platform): applying binding now: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding dsr-key --location=global --keyring=retention --member=serviceAccount:dsar-processor@redwood-prod --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` ETA 2m. will log the change.
anya (eng-security): once applied, run a small smoke test: attempt `kms.decrypt` against a test ciphertext and run deletion dry-run path. post the smoke result here.
sam (eng-platform): binding applied. smoke test output: `OK: kms.decrypt succeeded; deletion dry-run returned status OK`.
jules (eng-sre): retried blocked jobs: 17 -> 15 succeeded, 2 still failing due to `ENCRYPTED_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH` (old cache/previous version ciphertext). I'll escalate those two to manual cleanup.
marta (privacy): checked DSAR tracker: none breached SLA. legal flagged that we should document the outage and our compensating controls. they also asked about data minimization: if payloads are encrypted with rotated keys, does that affect our ability to prove deletion?
audit-bot: policy-change log: principal:sam@redwood added binding for dsar-processor@redwood-prod time:2026-03-21T04:17:40Z
anya (eng-security): root causes so far: (A) rotation script didn't retry on transient API error and didn't verify bindings post-rotation; (B) some ciphertexts still reference old key material causing decrypt mismatch. proposed fixes: add retry+backoff in rotation sync step, post-rotation smoke-check that exercises decrypt+delete dry-run, and add a retention-exceptions run manual path for ciphertext-version mismatches.
sam (eng-platform): I'll patch rotation pipeline to include a post-rotate verification step and a 3x retry for IAM sync. also add a GitHub PR with tests that mock transient failures.
jules (eng-sre): add alerting: page eng-security if deletion-service emits >3 PERMISSION_DENIED errors in 5m. also capture stack traces to a secure log for forensic review.
marta (privacy): legal wants a short incident note summarizing affected requests, timeline, mitigation, and proposed preventive steps. I'll draft and share. also: can we add a TTL+minimization policy so DSAR payloads use ephemeral encryption keys or cache fewer plaintexts to reduce blast radius?
anya (eng-security): good point. long-term: evaluate ephemeral KMS keys for deletion processing or encrypt-in-transit only with ephemeral session keys; add data-minimization checklist to privacy onboarding.
sam (eng-platform): will open infra task INFRA-2691 for rotation improvements and include smoke-check script `tools/keystore-smoke.sh`.
jules (eng-sre): manual cleanup complete for the 2 mismatched items. marking them done and attaching notes.
marta (privacy): legal notified, tracker updated. thanks team.
anya (eng-security): filing a brief postmortem and linking tasks: INFRA-2691, SEC-4202 (rotation RBAC guard), PRIV-101 (data-minimization eval). closing thread once postmortem links posted.
